title: Training Notes: Holder-Fare Credit on Crestline Companion Fares
content:
**What is the holder-fare credit?** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a credit against the companion fare that follows the base fare of the holder's own ticketed reservation paid by credit card — a ticket of Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand held by the holder, in ticketed status, whose form of payment is a credit card.

**How much is it?**

| Base fare of that ticket | Holder-fare credit |
|---|---|
| 400 USD or more | 10 USD |
| 250 USD to less than 400 USD | 5 USD |
| lower than 250 USD, or no such ticket | nothing |

**Does a ticket paid another way count?** No. Only a ticketed reservation paid by credit card is read; with no such ticket the credit is nothing.

**Where do the boundaries fall?** A base fare of exactly 400.00 USD gives 10 USD and 399.99 USD gives 5 USD; exactly 250.00 USD gives 5 USD and 249.99 USD gives nothing.
